title: [AdvancedPaste] Add "Paste as .jpg file" action with configurable JPEG quality

proposed_comments.title: Normalize unsupported and transparent bitmaps before JPEG encoding

confidence.rationale: The current implementation passes the clipboard bitmap directly to the JPEG encoder, which does not accept every pixel format and cannot preserve alpha correctly.

proposed_comments.body:
### Normalize unsupported and transparent bitmaps before JPEG encoding

**Severity:** `high`

`BitmapEncoder.SetSoftwareBitmap()` only accepts `Rgba16`, `Rgba8`, or `Bgra8`, and JPEG drops alpha instead of compositing it. A valid grayscale clipboard image can therefore fail here, and transparent PNG/icon content can produce black or dark fringes in the generated `.jpg`. Convert unsupported source formats to a supported opaque bitmap and flatten alpha onto a defined background before encoding; please add grayscale and transparent-image regression coverage alongside it.

proposed_comments.title: Preserve the existing persisted PasteFormats values

confidence.rationale: These enum values already flow into Advanced Paste telemetry and persisted payloads, so inserting JPEG here renumbers existing meanings.

proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve the existing persisted PasteFormats values

**Severity:** `high`

`PasteFormats` is already emitted through the Advanced Paste telemetry and persisted shortcut payloads. Inserting `PasteAsJpgFile` here renumbers `PasteAsHtmlFile`, both transcode formats, and the query/custom entries, so existing dashboards and saved IDs will be interpreted as different actions after upgrade. Keep the established numeric values stable and give the new JPEG format its own explicit ID instead of shifting the existing members.

proposed_comments.title: Skip the JPEG shortcut when its toggle is off

confidence.rationale: The current code appends the JPEG shortcut whenever the parent Paste as file group is visible, even if the JPEG child action itself is disabled.

proposed_comments.title: Keep legacy hotkey IDs aligned until settings are resaved

confidence.rationale: Deserialized settings will materialize the new JPEG subaction, but the native runner still enumerates only keys physically present in older JSON until the user saves again.

proposed_comments.body:
### Keep legacy hotkey IDs aligned until settings are resaved

**Severity:** `high`

`SubActions` now inserts JPEG before the existing HTML/transcode entries, but upgraded users will still have older raw settings files that do not contain a `paste-as-jpg-file` property yet. The settings side materializes the missing child from its initializer, while the native runner enumerates only the keys physically present in the legacy JSON. That shifts the runtime hotkey IDs until the user opens settings and saves again, so conflict UI and shortcut labels can point at the wrong action. Preserve the existing sequence for legacy files by adding an explicit migration or a native placeholder when the JPEG field is absent.

proposed_comments.title: Add compatibility coverage for the new persisted quality setting

confidence.rationale: The PR adds a new persisted paste-as-jpg-quality setting, but the current diff does not validate missing-field defaults or non-default round-trips.

proposed_comments.body:
### Add compatibility coverage for the new persisted quality setting

**Severity:** `medium`

This introduces a new persisted `paste-as-jpg-quality` field, but there is no settings serialization coverage proving that older Advanced Paste settings still load the default correctly or that a non-default value round-trips. Please add focused `Settings.UI.UnitTests` coverage for both cases so upgrades cannot silently regress the new setting.
